t: With a Manometer you can measure $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pressure/$ on a pneumatic network. Additionally, some Pneumatic machines/tubes have some special information about them. For instance, the $(l:tubes/safety_module)Safety Valve Tube Module/$ displays its safety threshold. So if you aren't feeling comfortable with redstone maths, this tool may be of use to you.
使用压力计，你可以测量气动网络中的$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压力/$。此外，一些气动机器/管道还会显示一些特殊信息。例如，$(l:tubes/safety_module)安全阀管道模块/$会显示其安全阈值。所以，如果你不太擅长红石计算，这个工具可能会对你有用。
With mods such as $(thing)The One Probe/$ or $(thing)WAILA/HWYLA/$ installed, the $(item)Manometer/$ may be of limited use.
安装了诸如$(thing)The One Probe/$或$(thing)WAILA/HWYLA/$之类的模组后，$(item)压力计/$的用途可能会比较有限。
